repository.name: MiroDiagramming
repository.description: Quick Tools imports graphs or cards from JSON or Excel files and builds diagrams on a Miro board. The application uses the Eclipse Layout Kernel (ELK) to arrange nodes and edges automatically. Shapes are generated from templates and each element can carry metadata that controls its appearance and placement.
